entries.description: apache runs no PHP module and is back on mpm_event: Sury's php meta had brought in PHP 8.6 with its apache module, which ran a customer's .phtml and .phar as www-data, outside his PHP pool. The panel's PHP takes the meta's place for roundcube
An export is a protected backup: it holds one of the package's backup slots instead of being adopted, so deleting it deletes its file
